pairs.why: A is chunkier and fills the frame with rounder, toy-like red caps, which matches the soft, bold shapes of the real cards better than B's smaller, flatter body.
B's cover is cleaner and smoother and its caps are neatly integrated, closer to the real cards' smooth finish; A's riveted cover reads slightly busier.
A has the fuller, rounder toy proportions of the real cards, while B is nearly identical but slightly flatter and less solid.
B has a smoother, more evenly lit chrome cover and cleaner construction, closer to the real cards' soft polish; A is nearly as good but reads a touch heavier.
A's rounded caps and chunky silhouette echo the real cards' bold toy shapes, while B's darker caps and rivets on the cover look a little more mechanical.
B is the cleaner, smoother read with neat caps; A is nearly the same, but its rivets on the cover and stronger reflections push it slightly toward the glossy statue look.
A has fuller, softer rounded caps and better presence in the frame, closer to the real cards; B is slightly flatter.
